title: Gate-elimination case certificate (one node of a case tree)
description: WP3.1. One JSON file per node. The full pattern of a node is the pattern of its parent (if inherit is true) extended by its own 'pattern'. Semantics: wp3/wp31_preregistration_2026-10-12.txt, Part 2, and gecheck/checker.py.

kind.description: union: the case is the union of its children (no own check); residual: configurations handed to a later WP, listed but not certified

paper_leaf.description: label of the paper leaf this node certifies (null: an unlabelled sub-case)

pre.description: ids of earlier cases whose trigger patterns are forbidden in every completion (the case order of the paper)

radius.description: normalizing transformations are applied to gates within this distance of the pattern

deg_cap.description: largest out-degree enumerated for nodes whose out-degree is not fixed

actions.description: alternative actions; a completion is discharged if one of them (or an ancestor's) achieves one of its claimed types

symmetries.description: pattern automorphisms (node renamings) tried when matching children; checked to be automorphisms

out.description: exact out-degree, or [lo, hi] with hi null meaning up to deg_cap

prot.description: protected variable (right-hand side of a quadratic equality)

edges.description: [u, v]: u feeds v; each edge into v occupies one input slot

partner.description: two protected variables of one quadratic equality

types.description: FGHK rev. 2 substitution types (p.22-23) claimed for this action

kind.description: const: var <- c; affine: var <- src + c with src an input; quadratic: var <- (u+a)(v+b)+c computed at the and-gate src fed by inputs u, v

value.description: the constant c, or the gate that the constant must make constant (the checker tries both c and requires the gate to be removed by Transformation 2)
